premise_flaw: the shard is real and measured, lane=128s on run 35112954817 against 330s before, but it is not the larger number. LD-81 measures the conductor suite's cost per test rising from 123.2 ms/test on 2026-09-14 to 228.8 ms/test on 2026-09-16, already per test so the suite growing is not the explanation, and at today's 1478 tests that span is 156s of conductor wall, more than sharding saves. The shard redistributes a cost that itself grew 1.86x in three days and whose cause is not measured. Anyone reading the shard as the fix will be surprised when the lane job drifts back over 150s, and 128s leaves only 22s of margin.
